Head-sha: `0fb4902a9b9e86dbfd43e819e0afb3f2acbb587b`
Local-runs: none
Scope: skills/objectstack-data/SKILL.md, skills/objectstack-data/rules/relationships.md, skills/objectstack-data/rules/naming.md, skills/objectstack-data/references/seeds.md, skills/objectstack-data/evals/objects-fields-relationships.json, skills/objectstack-data/evals/hooks-security-seeds-datasources.json, scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs, .changeset/31155-port-authoring-rules-data.md + packages/spec/src/data/object.zod.ts, packages/spec/src/data/field.zod.ts, packages/spec/src/data/field-value.zod.ts, packages/spec/src/data/validation.zod.ts, packages/objectql/src/validation/record-validator.ts, packages/metadata-protocol/src/seed-loader.ts, packages/cli/src/utils/seed-record-values.ts, packages/cli/src/commands/migrate/summary-nulls.ts, ui/packages/components/src/renderers/form/checkbox.tsx, skills/objectstack-data/rules/field-types.md, skills/objectstack-data/rules/validation.md, skills/objectstack-data/rules/security.md, skills/objectstack-automation/SKILL.md (all on `origin/main` fe97d85b), cloud `packages/service-ai-studio/src/skills/metadata-authoring-skill.ts` and `solution-design-skill.ts` (cloud `main`)

Inputs read: card #31155 body and comments 6709262673, 6709364829 (claim), 6709466914 (triage), 6711215678 (ledger), 6711263510 (dev report); cloud#3659 body and comments 6681920672, 6682024726 (ruling A), 6708590694; ruling record 6513306068 (#27847); PR #31223 body, file list, diff vs merge-base 8ef4d309 and vs `origin/main` fe97d85b; check-runs on the head (re-read at 2026-11-07T18:33Z); the two cloud corpus files. Byte counts below were read off `git show` with the ratchet header's own hand-audit formula, not by running the gate.

### ① Derived judgments

Faithfulness against `packages/spec` and the runtime on `main` — every ported sentence was checked; these hold:

- Rule 18 (boolean never `required`): `field.zod.ts` L1323 defines `required` as the non-null presence contract and refuses nothing on `boolean` / `toggle` (class E/R, correctly left to the spec lane); `defaultValue` is "applied on INSERT when the field is omitted or null" (L1395), so "lands seeded or imported rows on a real `false`" is true; the Console checkbox renderer (`ui/packages/components/src/renderers/form/checkbox.tsx` L49) passes `required={schema.required}` to the control, so "a form that reads it that way refuses the unchecked state" is literally the shipped form. Judgment the schema cannot express — class 3, correctly placed.
- Rule 19d (dynamic default is save-time): tokens `NOW()` / `current_user` / CEL envelope, resolved on INSERT (`field.zod.ts` L1395). True; class 3.
- Rule 16 (owner is `owner_id`): `object.zod.ts` L3092–3123 — `user` default injects reassignable `owner_id`, `org` / `none` for "catalog / junction tables". True; class 3. `created_by` is a system column (`field-group-layout.ts` L98). True.
- Rule 16b (posture from the request): `sharingModel` enum describe L3745 — `public_read` "everyone reads, owner writes", `private` owner-only. True; class 3. The hosted auto-default half was correctly dropped (the published skill already says a publish without `sharingModel` is refused).
- Rule 15 (function from the words, qualifier in `filter`): `summaryOperations.function` ∈ count/sum/min/max/avg, `filter` a FilterCondition ANDed with the parent link, "recomputes when child records are inserted/updated/deleted" (`field.zod.ts` L2178–2193). True; class 3.
- Rule 17 (`initialStates`): `validation.zod.ts` L197 describe matches the mechanic. Judgment half ("whenever the status has a real start; only genuine entry states, never terminal; values not labels") is class 3.
- People fields: a `user` field's target is fixed to `sys_user`, any other `reference` refused at parse (`field.zod.ts` L2794–2825). "No `reference`" is true.
- select-options / process-modeling: status-as-`select`, approvals-are-flow-nodes agree with `skills/objectstack-automation/SKILL.md` L105 (`approval` node). No contradiction with the i18n skill on labels (it teaches translation bundles, not an English default).
- Rule 19 (seeds): `record-validator.ts` L154/171 `EMAIL_RE`, `PHONE_RE = /^[+()\-\s\d.]{5,}$/` refuse `138****4207`, `N/A`, `***`, `TBD`; `seed-loader.ts` runs the record validator per row and continues (`declaresSeedClientRefusal`), so "loads short" is the loader's behaviour. True.
- Tool-agnostic: no cloud tool name (`verify_build`, `create_seed`, `apply_blueprint`, `describe_object`) and no hosted-only rule in any skill hunk. The blueprint spellings (`conditions`, dashboard `aggregate`) were correctly not ported.

Misclassified or untrue sentences:

- **MUST-FIX (false against the runtime on `main`)** — `rules/relationships.md` § Roll-up Summaries, "**No backfill.** … leaves every parent blank until a child is edited — declare it with the object, or touch a child record". `packages/cli/src/commands/migrate/summary-nulls.ts` (L43–70) is the backfill: `os migrate summary-nulls --apply` recomputes every `NULL` count/sum parent, and `--recompute-undefined-on-empty object.field` is documented for exactly "a summary field declared after its parent rows already existed". The published skill prescribes a workaround ("touch a child record") where the platform ships the command, and eval case 10's `expected_output` repeats the wrong remedy ("stays blank until a task is edited"). Keep the true half (the automatic recompute runs only on a child write) and name the migration as the remedy; `rules/field-types.md` L174 already uses this idiom for `os migrate record-currency-codes`.
- `SKILL.md` § Validation Patterns, "`transitions` governs only UPDATE and a `select` accepts any option on insert, so without it a record can be created already `approved`" — class 1: a near-verbatim restatement of the spec `.describe()` (`validation.zod.ts` L197), and `rules/validation.md` L16 already says "insert: `initialStates`". Only the entry-state judgment is class 3. Related design gap in ④.
- `rules/relationships.md`, "Every `filter` key is a field on the CHILD object and a select's value is its option `value`, never its label" — the seat's own ledger lists this as enforce-or-remove row 7 ("not written as prose; listed for the spec lane"), yet it is written as prose here. Either the ledger row or the sentence is misfiled; the value-vs-label half is judgment and may stay, the child-field half is the E/R row.
- `references/seeds.md`, "a value the field type refuses never lands — the table loads short or empty" — true of the loader, but on `main` `os validate` / `os build` refuse a malformed seed value at authoring time through the same record validator (`packages/cli/src/utils/seed-record-values.ts`, #27259). The paragraph ports the hosted failure mode and omits the open gate the skill's own "Verify your work" section tells the agent to run. Should-fix: one clause.

### ② Semver level

`.changeset/31155-port-authoring-rules-data.md`: `'@objectstack/skills': patch` with line-initial `Clause-②: no` and `Metadata-protocol: none`; the PR body carries the same two lines at L3–4. Correct: docs and eval fixtures only, no authorable key, value or default changes, so `none` takes `patch` (AGENTS.md Post-Task Checklist step 3), matching the package's precedent changesets (28804, 28819, 29395, 29411). No `skip-changeset`. `Part of #31155` keeps the card open for the automation and ui ports, as the ledger says. Accepted.

### ③ Boundary flags

**Token-ratchet raises (three rows, `scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`):**

- Authority is real. Comment 6682024726 is cloud#3659's letter-A ruling (maintainer 「A」, 2026-11-06): "How to write valid, working metadata lives in the public skills … The private corpus's rules of that kind move there." Record 6513306068 is #27847's letter-B ruling (maintainer 「其他同意」, 2026-10-30) that made the 2026-10-27 standing ruling 「A:先削重复,余额按实测提高」 the gate-recognised path; the ratchet header on `main` (L138–156) states both forms: same-file deletion shown plus the quote in the PR body, and "a ruling of record that orders text into a file still authorises its own measured delta". The PR body quotes the 2026-10-27 words verbatim and names both records (L34). Both authorise THIS raise: the text is ordered in by cloud#3659 A.
- `SKILL.md` 6078 → 6677: same-file pay-downs are in the diff (the `unique` blockquote collapsed to a pointer; the `secret` / `user` parentheticals removed — both restated `rules/validation.md` § Uniqueness and `rules/field-types.md` rows 42–43 / 96, verified). Head file 26727 bytes, stamp line `  version: "18.3.0"` 20 bytes → 26707 priced → ceil(26707/4) = 6677. Pinned AT the measurement, headroom 0. Holds.
- `references/seeds.md` 1566 → 1718: no same-file deletion; the comment says so honestly ("the file said nothing about seed values" — confirmed against the file on `main`). Authorised under the ordering-ruling clause; 6870 bytes → 1718, pinned at the measurement. Holds.
- **MUST-FIX** — `rules/relationships.md` 3873 → 4095 is pinned at the head's 16380 bytes, but `origin/main` moved this file after the merge-base (commit range 8ef4d309..fe97d85b: `sharingModel` stamped on every example, the duplicate `post_tag` block replaced by a pointer): `main` is now 15489 bytes = 3873 tokens, headroom 0. The three-way merge applies cleanly to this file and yields 16391 bytes → 4098 tokens, three over the pinned 4095 — the ratchet reds on the merged tree the queue builds. The script comment's base figure (15478 → 16380) is also stale. Rebase, re-measure, re-pin.
- Should-fix: the PR body's raise table (L38) says 26700 bytes / 6675 / +597 for `SKILL.md`; the script and the body's own Verification section say 26707 / 6677 / +599. The body is the carrier the ruling names for "ruling id + measured delta"; correct the table.

**Merge state — MUST-FIX.** GitHub reports the head `mergeable: false`, `mergeable_state: dirty`; `git merge-tree origin/main 0fb4902a` conflicts in both eval files. `main` landed `objects-fields-relationships.json` cases 8 and 9 and `hooks-security-seeds-datasources.json` case 11 after the base; this PR adds 8–12 and 11–13 under the same ids. The body's "ids 1–12 and 1–13 contiguous" was true at 8ef4d309 and is false against `main`. Rebase and renumber (10–14 and 12–14), then fix every case number in the PR body, the ledger comment and the changeset.

**Governed surface.** Every `skills/**` path is Tier H in `GOVERNED_SURFACES`; this record is the contract-tier review the dispatch ordered and the body correctly says landing waits for the maintainer's APPROVED review with the PR kept draft. No seat may arm, queue or flip it.

**Check-runs on the head (final read 2026-11-07T18:33Z):** `total_count` 0 — no GitHub Actions check-run exists on 0fb4902a; the five app check-suites (vercel, fly-io, claude, cloudflare-workers-and-pages, objectstack-fleet) are `queued` with zero runs each. "Every check is green" cannot be read on this head; the dev's CI readings (`Lint & Repo Gates`, `Test Core`, `Build Core`, `Governed Surface Queue Guard`) were reported as `in_progress` and are not on this commit now.

### ④ Design judgment

Judged from the seat of a customer agent that loads the whole `@objectstack/skills` package:

- Value density: the boolean, dynamic-default, people-field, owner, status-as-select, approvals-not-objects and roll-up-qualifier lines each change what an agent writes and are absent from the skill on `main` (checked `SKILL.md`, `rules/field-types.md`, `rules/validation.md`, `rules/security.md`, `references/seeds.md`, `rules/naming.md`). The sharing-posture paragraph adds the "which value" judgment the four-row table lacks. Same-file pay-downs are genuine deletions of restatement, not re-wraps.
- **Must-fix carried from ①:** the "No backfill" paragraph and eval 10 teach a wrong remedy against the runtime on `main`.
- Should-fix — contradiction by example: the new posture paragraph says a shared business object is `public_read_write`, reference data `public_read`, `private` only for personal or sensitive data; the skill's own examples teach the opposite habit — `rules/relationships.md` on `main` now stamps `sharingModel: 'private'` on `account`, `contact`, `invoice`, `project`, `employee`, the `project_assignment` junction and the `category` reference table; `SKILL.md` § Conditional Field Rules has `invoice` as `private`; `main`'s new eval case 8 requires `project` `private`. All are valid spec values, but an agent reads examples before prose. Align the examples (or qualify the paragraph) in the same PR or a named follow-up.
- Should-fix — `rules/validation.md` § State Machine Validation, the canonical example an agent copies, declares no `initialStates`, while the new `SKILL.md` sentence says to add it whenever the status has a real start (the example's `draft` is one). Add `initialStates: ['draft']` to the example and keep only the judgment in `SKILL.md`; eval case 9 then tests a rule the examples do not undercut.
- Evals: cases 8, 9, 11, 12, 13 and hooks 11–13 test the ported behaviour with `must_not_contain` on the exact anti-patterns (`required: true` on the flag, a `reference` to a user table, a status table, the label in a `filter`, an English label on a Chinese brief, `public_read_write` where the request implies a posture). They parse and are self-consistent. Case 10's expected_output inherits the backfill error (above). Case 11's `must_not_contain: ["ownership: 'user'"]` is consistent with the row's "(`ownership: 'user'`, the default)" and the cloud rule's "do not pass it".
- No duplicate of existing text was introduced except the `initialStates` mechanic (①). Tool-agnostic wording holds; Chinese trigger words (是否…, 已完成) are the user's vocabulary, not a hosted term. Role-word check already passed after the reword.

Must-fix set for the next head: (1) rebase onto `main`, resolve the two eval conflicts and renumber the cases; (2) re-measure and re-pin `rules/relationships.md` (and refresh the comment's base bytes) on the rebased tree; (3) rewrite "No backfill" and eval 10 around `os migrate summary-nulls`. Should-fix: the body's raise table, the `initialStates` example in `rules/validation.md`, the `private`-by-habit examples, and the `os validate` clause in `references/seeds.md`.

### ① Derived judgments

The three must-fixes of the previous record, on this head:

1. **Merge state / eval renumbering — fixed.** `origin/main` (fe97d85b) is merged in by 9bed005a; GitHub reports `mergeable: true`, `mergeable_state: clean`, and `git merge-tree origin/main c92f2f54` against today's `main` (714dda8f) is conflict-free. `main`'s cases (objects 8–9, hooks 11) are kept; this PR's cases are 10–14 and 12–14, ids 1–14 contiguous in both files; the changeset, the PR body and the ledger correction 6711710289 carry the new numbers consistently. `main` has not moved any PR file since fe97d85b (diff empty on `skills/`, the ratchet script and the changeset).
